title: The Frostwake Spire
theme: Arctic temple of ice bridges, frozen side courts, and a central awakening chamber
hook: A cold blue light has begun pulsing from an abandoned temple beyond the snowline. The local guides fear the old star-bell is waking under the ice and ask the party to silence it before the pass freezes shut.
background:
The Frostwake Spire was raised around a star-bell said to hold winter in balance. For generations it slept beneath the central nave, but a blue pulse now beats through the ice, freezing pack animals in their traces and sealing the mountain pass a little more each night.

The party enters to silence or soothe the star-bell before the next storm locks the road until spring. The temple is still passable, but its bridges are brittle, its side courts hold half-buried offerings, and old frost signs stir when disturbed.

The central nave is quiet at first. After the party visits the outer signs in Rooms 3, 5, 6, and 8, returning to the nave awakens the Frostwake Warden, which tests whether the party has come to restore the old vows or steal the bell outright.

rooms.name: Snow-Buried Lower Stair
rooms.readAloud: A stair of pale stone climbs from a trough of wind-packed snow. Frost has sealed old lantern niches along both sides.
rooms.gmNotes: This is the obvious entry. The cold is natural here, but boot prints show repeated travel toward the central ice court.
rooms.treasure: A cracked ivory way-token is frozen under the lowest exposed step.
rooms.secrets: The lantern niches hum faintly when the four outer frost signs in Rooms 3, 5, 6, and 8 have all been disturbed.
rooms.exits: Up the clear stair to Room 2.

structuredExits.label: Route to Room 2
structuredExits.description: Up the clear stair to Room 2.

rooms.name: Frostwake Nave
rooms.readAloud: A broad central court lies under a skin of blue-white ice. Bridges, stairs, and broken snow trails radiate from a sunken star symbol at the center.
rooms.gmNotes: The boss marker belongs here, but the Frostwake Warden appears only after the party visits Rooms 3, 5, 6, and 8, then returns to this chamber. Treasure markers here indicate paired offerings frozen into the nave floor.

inhabitants.name: Frostwake Warden
inhabitants.tactics: Manifests at the star symbol after four outer signs are visited, then divides the nave with walls of rime
inhabitants.morale: Stands down if the party returns the three frost-vows instead of forcing open the spire
inhabitants.wants: Keep the star-bell asleep until the thaw rite is completed
inhabitants.leverage: It obeys old temple vows, careful offerings, and proof that the pass is in danger

rooms.treasure: Two paired moon-silver offering bowls are sealed in ice at opposite sides of the nave.
rooms.secrets: The star symbol brightens one point at a time after Rooms 3, 5, 6, and 8 are visited; all four points awaken the warden on return.
rooms.exits: Stair to Room 1, clear bridge to Room 3, stair to Room 4, bridge to Room 5, bridge to Room 6, bridge to Room 7, bridge and hazardous frost trail to Room 8, and stair to Room 9.

rooms.name: Western Reliquary Shelf
rooms.readAloud: A low shelf of ice-crusted stone holds cracked reliquary boxes. Snow has blown through a collapsed arch and gathered in small drifts.
rooms.gmNotes: This treasure room is one of the four outer signs needed to trigger the warden when the party returns to Room 2.
rooms.treasure: A frostglass reliquary cap, two silver finger rings, and a waxed prayer strip remain intact.
rooms.secrets: A carved sign under the largest reliquary shows the same star point found in Room 2.
rooms.exits: Clear bridge to Room 2, or trail along the western snow shelf to Room 8.

rooms.name: Collapsed South Font
rooms.readAloud: A broken basin sits half-buried below the main court. Its frozen water is full of trapped leaves that should not survive this high in the pass.
rooms.gmNotes: This side platform is quiet and useful for regrouping, but the basin echoes any loud plan into Room 2.
rooms.treasure: A pale stone stopper from the old font can be sold to temple collectors.
rooms.secrets: The trapped leaves point toward the latest room visited by the party.

rooms.name: Eastern Wind Bridge
rooms.readAloud: An exposed bridge crosses a blue crevasse toward a storm-polished platform. Snow streams sideways across the stones.
rooms.gmNotes: The hazard marker belongs to the lower wind-scoured edge. This is one of the four outer signs needed to trigger the Room 2 warden.
rooms.treasure: A broken bronze bell-clapper is wedged into ice near the safe side of the bridge.
rooms.secrets: The hazardous side trail beside the bridge is older than the temple stairs and leads back toward Room 2.
rooms.exits: Clear bridge to Room 2; a hazardous frost trail also skirts back toward the same central court.

rooms.name: High Mirror Gallery
rooms.readAloud: Polished ice mirrors lean in a roofless gallery. They reflect the sky even when the clouds close overhead.
rooms.gmNotes: Visiting this gallery marks another outer sign for the delayed boss trigger. The mirrors show Room 2 with one extra shadow after the second outer sign is disturbed.
rooms.treasure: A hand mirror backed with blue enamel is hidden behind a cracked ice slab.
rooms.secrets: The mirrors reflect the safe order for returning frost-vows to the nave.

rooms.name: North Bell Stair
rooms.readAloud: A narrow stair climbs toward a stone bell frame rimed in frost. The bell is missing, but the air trembles as if it has just rung.
rooms.gmNotes: This room points to the objective in Room 9. It is connected to Room 2 by a clear but exposed bridge.
rooms.treasure: A frost-cracked bell inscription can be copied for a reward from mountain archivists.
rooms.secrets: The missing bell was not stolen; it is sealed below the star dais in Room 9.

rooms.name: Left-Hand Rime Court
rooms.readAloud: A side court is packed with brittle snow, and a broken wall exposes dark ice beneath the ruin. The cold here has teeth.
rooms.gmNotes: The hazard marker belongs here. This is one of the four outer signs needed to trigger the Room 2 warden, and it also links by trail to Room 3.
rooms.treasure: A pouch of old blue salt is frozen into the broken wall.
rooms.secrets: A hazardous frost trail runs beside the clear bridge back to Room 2, and the safer snow shelf reaches Room 3.
rooms.exits: Clear bridge and hazardous frost trail to Room 2, or clear trail along the western shelf to Room 3.

rooms.name: Star-Bell Dais
rooms.readAloud: At the highest point of the temple, a circular dais holds a sealed star-shaped cover. Beneath it, something rings without sound.
rooms.gmNotes: This is the objective area. Opening it before resolving the Room 2 warden releases a freezing pulse through every bridge.
rooms.treasure: The sleeping star-bell can be silenced with the restored frost-vows or carried away at great risk.
rooms.secrets: The bell calms if the party returns with offerings from Rooms 3, 5, 6, and 8 and speaks them in Room 2 before opening the dais.

gmNotes: Use the visible arctic temple, bridges, side courts, and upper dais as the play surface; cold, exposure, and brittle crossings should matter.
Normal route overlays are disabled on the premium map because visible bridges, stairs, and snow paths belong to the art.
The duplicated 2-5 and 2-8 draft routes were consolidated into single structural connections with notes about the hazardous alternate trails so validation stays unambiguous.
The Frostwake Warden appears in Room 2 only after the party visits Rooms 3, 5, 6, and 8 and then returns to the central nave.
